specs.Compatible Devices: DVD Player, DVR, Laptop, Monitor, Projector

features: 【Plug and Play, Easy to Use, Aluminum Alloy】 The wireless HDMI video transmitter and receiver is made of aluminum alloy for better heat dissipation, and the plug-and-play portable design eliminates the need for complicated installation or wiring. Simply connect the transmitter to the HDMI port of your computer or other audio/video source, and then connect the receiver to the HDMI input port of your TV, projector or monitor. Wait 5-10 seconds for HD projection to begin. Make your presentations, movie watching or teaching activities more efficient and convenient.

【656ft/200M Long Distance Transmission】: The HDMI wireless transmitter and receiver support wireless video transmission up to 656ft, and its long wireless transmission distance combined with a 5DB high-gain Wi-Fi antenna ensures a stable and reliable signal even in complex and changing environments. In large-scale activities, or film and television shooting scenes, the wireless hdmi transmitter and receiver can easily cover a wide range of areas to ensure continuous transmission of video, so that every corner can be synchronized to show the wonderful picture, for the smooth progress of the activities and film and television creations to carry out efficiently provides a solid guarantee.

【Ultra-low Latency】: The ultra-low latency of wireless HDMI extender kit is undoubtedly a blessing for live broadcasting, filming, real-time monitoring and other occasions that require high synchronization of images. The system's ultra-low latency of only 50 milliseconds allows directors and cinematographers to view real-time images of movie scenes on mobile monitors with almost no noticeable delay, allowing them to quickly and accurately respond to and adjust the progress of filming, ensuring that filming goes smoothly and capturing every moment, laying the foundation for high-quality film and television productions.

【1080P HD transmission】: HDMI wireless video transmitter and receiver adopts advanced H.264 codec technology and supports 1080P 60Hz high refresh rate, which brings users clear, smooth, detailed and realistic picture effect. Whether you are enjoying a stunning blockbuster movie in the home theater or immersing yourself in exciting content in a high-definition video viewing scenario, the system is able to perfectly render the details of the picture even on a 200-inch screen, allowing users to enjoy a high-quality visual feast, completely get rid of the cumbersome constraints of wired connections, and open up a new era of wireless high-definition video transmission.

【APP expansion, Android & IO-S multi-device reception】: The HDMI wireless transmitter and receiver are equipped with the wireless reception APP Android and IOS systems. When using a single wireless transmitter, users can simultaneously receive pictures on a mobile phone or tablet with installed. Supports up to 1 transmitter and 4 receivers, providing users with a more diverse reception and convenient mobile monitoring experience to meet the individual needs of different scenarios
